24. OCP — Open/Closed Principle

SIMPLE ENGLISH
A module should be open for extension and closed to unnecessary modification. Stable
abstractions can support new behaviors.

Q: Does OCP forbid all edits?
A: No. It guides stable extension points; bug fixes and changing requirements may still require
modification.
